=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text first "first 61 terms:"
text rec "first term of each decimal length, below index 1000000:\n"
text fu "fusc("
text eqs ") = "
note fu n is fusc(n) for n below 10^6
global fs ulong 1000000
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
fn digits n ulong to ulong
k = ulong 1
v = div n 10
while gt v 0 bound 20
k = add k 1
v = div v 10
end
ret k
end
note fusc(0) = 0, fusc(1) = 1, fusc(2n) = fusc(n), fusc(2n+1) = fusc(n) + fusc(n+1); each needs only smaller indices
fn main to int
put fs 1 1
for i ulong 999998
n = add i 2
h = shr n 1
if eq rem n 2 0
put fs n get fs h
else
put fs n add get fs h get fs add h 1
end
end
emit first
for i ulong 61
emit sp
emitu get fs i
end
emit nl
emit rec
w = ulong 0
for n ulong 1000000
d = digits get fs n
if gt d w
w = d
emit fu
emitu n
emit eqs
emitu get fs n
emit nl
end
end
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
first 61 terms: 0 1 1 2 1 3 2 3 1 4 3 5 2 5 3 4 1 5 4 7 3 8 5 7 2 7 5 8 3 7 4 5 1 6 5 9 4 11 7 10 3 11 8 13 5 12 7 9 2 9 7 12 5 13 8 11 3 10 7 11 4
first term of each decimal length, below index 1000000:
fusc(0) = 0
fusc(37) = 11
fusc(1173) = 108
fusc(35499) = 1076
fusc(699051) = 10946
</pre>
